coding_next_steps.action: Define ledger schema (task states: executing/validated/delivery_pending/delivered/delivery_failed) and idempotency keys (conversation_id+event_id).
Control plane (Cloudflare DO/KV) stores idempotency keys and outbox; execution runs remotely (SWE‑ReX or Coder) and writes artifacts to R2/S3 before marking complete.
Add tests for: abrupt workspace shutdown→resume; delivery failure→resend from artifact store; no-empty-artifact validator before marking complete.

props.title: Coding-agent alternatives — SWE‑ReX / mini‑SWE‑agent vs Coder Tasks / AgentAPI

props.content: This comparison focuses on what each stack provides out-of-the-box for execution durability and what remains integrator work. SWE‑ReX / mini‑SWE‑agent excel at flight-recording and interactive execution; Coder Tasks + AgentAPI provide control‑plane features (workspace provisioning, pause/resume, identity mapping) closer to production guarantees. None enforce end‑to‑end external channel delivery ack without additional glue.
